dump_hyperparams_to_base64: create a function that compresses and base64-encodes XP hyper-params for sharing via paste or email
load_hyperparams_from_base64: create a function that decodes a base64 string and decompresses it back into XP hyper-params
export_xp_sigs: run the export action to serialize multiple XP signatures into a shareable base64 encoded string
import_xp_from_stdin: run the import action to read base64 encoded XP hyper-params from stdin and initialize them
review_share_module: review the share module functions for exporting and importing XP hyper-params via base64 encoding
